name: cloexec
description: fcntl(2) and close-on-exec: F_GETFD/F_SETFD, FIOCLEX/FIONCLEX, F_DUPFD (lowest at or above arg, flag clear), F_GETFL (O_WRONLY|O_APPEND), EBADF and EINVAL; then a descriptor marked close-on-exec is gone in a vfork+execv child and a spawnv child, and unmarked ones survive.
